name: Tune advisor reply is refused unless it is the layout this suite knows
step: Check the tune advisor codec refuses an unknown payload version or length
rationale:
Issue #2493: the tune advisor decode() read the payload version byte and never
compared it, and ran with no length guard. A reply of another layout decoded into
plausible numbers, and tune_history saves them to the flight-history file. The codec now
refuses a reply that is not 51 bytes or not payload version 3 (the packed layout), and
reports the reason through the error path.

No build and no package step reaches this -- it is a reply path through the codec. The
harness drives the real codec through its read message with the simulator's 51-byte
reply, a reply packed with string.pack from the firmware's layout (so the byte order is
checked against msp.c, not against the codec itself), an old version-2 reply, a version-4
reply, a truncated reply and a longer reply.
